column5: The bounded model decodes one LockInfo or SharedLock wrapper and admits only optimistic non-async non-file locks. Pessimistic, async-commit, file, write, 2PC, 1PC, and broader lock metadata remain UNTRIAGED.

The retained synchronous path routes CheckTxnStatus and exact-key ResolveLock through the same RegionCache/client/deadline/cancellation authority and returns committed, rolled-back, or exact remaining TTL. TxnNotFound retry, batch resolve, pessimistic and async locks, writes, background cleanup, and production concurrency remain UNTRIAGED.

A locked Cop response records route success, performs bounded optimistic status/resolve handling, and retries only the same unconsumed task without paging, EMA, cache publication, or duplicate response mutation. Batch reads, background resolution, TxnNotFound retry, pessimistic/async locks, and write paths remain UNTRIAGED.
